review.rationale: The prospective Decision is strictly bounded to four sequential, gated model requests (Lane B adjudication, Lane C replacement, Lane D review, synthesis) with zero retries, fallbacks, or model substitutions. It is deterministic: every gate, input hash, patch SHA, and contract schema is explicitly frozen and verified before each step. It is fail-closed: any hash drift, non-exact model return, transport/JSON failure, contract violation, incomplete finding coverage, or non-qualifying lane immediately terminates the sequence without repair, extraction, or retry. Authority boundaries are fully preserved: the Decision explicitly prohibits source remediation, GitHub review/comment submission, PR mutation, merge, release, deployment, and any Standard/production/commercial status change; it only authorizes the exact review and adjudication requests stated, persisting sanitized results and one bounded report on the governance branch. All non-authorizations are explicitly declared and aligned with the standing directive.
